front_blocks.md: Define **Hitler Youth**.

back_blocks.md: The **Hitler Youth** was the Nazi youth group for boys aged 14 to 18, which focused on physical and military training to create an army for the future.

front_blocks.md: Define **Lebensborn Programme**.
